backlog.title: Why Cancer and Virgo Can Feel Lonely Together
backlog.hook: Cancer and Virgo can feel lonely together.
backlog.angle: Cancer × Virgo | Dual AI host | verdict_echo. The first adult woman states the paradox; the second briefly agrees, then explains one behavior-first mechanism: both people may care deeply, but overwhelm, criticism, or withdrawal can make care hard to feel in the moment. Use one observable relationship scene and keep the counter-view explicit: Sun signs do not cause emotional unavailability, and individual communication matters more than the label.
